findings.title: Optimized pagination cannot handle audit-log datetimes
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint orders by `datetime`, so each item key here is a `datetime` object. Passing it to `math.floor` raises `TypeError` on the first non-empty page when `optimized_pagination=true` is used by an authorized administrator. The cursor conversion also returns the raw integer value rather than converting it back to a datetime, so subsequent-page filtering would fail too. Use the datetime key and cursor conversions from `DateTimePaginator`.

findings.title: Negative QuerySet offsets are not supported by Django
findings.body: This branch passes a negative start index to a Django QuerySet slice. Django raises `ValueError` for negative slice indices rather than treating them as offsets from the end, so an authorized request using the advertised negative-offset pagination path fails instead of returning a page. Implement reverse traversal without negative slicing, or reject negative offsets explicitly.
